text.body: śrī gaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrī gurubhyo namaḥ || || advaitarasamañjarī || akhaṇḍasatyajñānānandāmṛtasyātmastava stavādikaṃ kathaṃ kuryāṃ karaṇāgocaratvataḥ || 1 || svabhaktalokānujidhṛkṣayaivayā samastalokānugatā virājate | akādirūpeṇa śukādivanditāṃ namāmi taṃ śrīlalitāṃ svadevatām || 2 || gajamukhamupariṣṭānmānavāṅgaṃ tvadhastā naraparaparamaikyajñāpanāyabhyupetya | parilasatiparastānmohajālānmahoya ttadiha mama purastādastu vastupaśastam || 3 || vaṭatarunikaṭe śrīdakṣiṇāmūrtirūpaṃ yadadhivasati saccinmudrayā bhadrayārtham | paramamamṛtamantevāsināṃ saṃpradātuṃ tadihavaradamekaṃ bhāvaye bhāvaśūnyam || 4 || yatīndramaṇḍalaṃ dhyāyannakhaṇḍarasamaṇḍalam | advaitarasamañjaryāḥ kurvedya suvikāsinīm || 5 || abaddhā'pi subaddhaiṣā satā baddhasudṛṣṭinā | bhavetsantoṣavanto hi santassanti samekṣaṇāḥ || 6 || pādaśūnyapatagāyitasya me kheratvamatidurlabhaṃ khalu | tadvido'pi tadavāptumicchata ssāhasaṃ sahatu sauhṛdījanaḥ || 7 || advaitameva paramārthatayā vivektu maṅgīkṛtadvipanarākṛtisanniveśaḥ | advaitagocaramaśeṣavidoṣamanta rāviṣkarotu varado mama vighnarājaḥ || 1|| ajñānavisphuradanekavidhātmabheda majñānamāśrivatassulabhā na muktiḥ | ādarśagehamamitaḥ pratibimbitānta rdvāraṃ gatasya na bahirgatirarbhakasya || 2|| śāntyādisādhanavatā puruṣottamena saṃprāpyate nijapadaṃ varadeśikoktyā | corairaṇyasariṇīṃ gamitena puṃsā deśo nijo hi tadabhijñagiraiva gamyaḥ || 3|| bhūmā bhavāniti gurūpaniṣadvacobhiḥ kartrātmatā galati siddhyati bhūmabhāvaḥ | rājātmajasya nijatatvanibodhanena vyādhātmatāvigalanādiva rājabhāvaḥ || 4|| kūṭasthanityasukhabodhatanoḥ pratīco bandho vimocanamiti bhrama durvilāsaḥ | vandhyāsutasya vapurādiguṇaprapañca statpañcatā'pi sutarāṃ parikalpanaiva || 5|| āpātataḥ pratibhayā jagadastivādaḥ satyaṃ nirūpaṇavidhau na hi kiñcidasti | bhīrorvibhāti paritastimiraṃ piśāca statraiva dīpakalikā''nayate kimasti || 6|| cijjyotireva jagadātmatayā cakāsti vastvantaraṃ kimapi nāsti vicāryamāṇe | rajjvau bhramādhikaraṇādapi rajjusarpa tatvāntaraṃ bhavitumarhati kiṃ kathañcit || 7|| viśvaṃ samastamapi vibhramamātrameta dātmaiva sannayananyasukhaprakāśaḥ | sphūrtyaiva viśvamapi satyamitīryate cet ko nāma śuktirajatena dhanīnabhāvi || 8|| nāsti pratītyavasare na purā na paścā dāścaryametadavabhāti tathā'pi viśvam | yadvā kimadbhutaviveha mahendrajālaṃ māyāvikalpitamiti pratibhāsate hi || 9|| eko'pi sannayamanekatayā vibhāti bhūmā svakalpitatamaḥ paṭalānuṣaṅgāt | indurdvitīyarahito'pi ca sadvitīya bhāvena bhāti puruṣasya nijākṣidoṣāt || 10|| ālokyate bhuvanacakramalātacakra matyantavibhramavijṛmbhitamasthiraṃ ca | daivāt bhramasyaviratau samupasthitāyāṃ nālokyate kila pureva punastadeva || 11|| gandharvapattanamidaṃ jagadavyavasthaṃ caitanyanāmani vihāyasi naścakāsti | vidyotate yadi ca vidyudivātmavidyā sadyastirobhavati sarvamidaṃ tadaiva || 12|| āropitasya jagataḥ pravilāpanena cittaṃ śivātmakatayā pariśiṣyate naḥ | śatrūn nihatya hatayinturadhoniprātāt gandhadvipo bhavati kevalamadvitīyaḥ || 13|| adyāstametu vapurāśitāramāstāṃ kastāvatāpi mama cidvapuṣo viśeṣaḥ | kumbhe'pi naśyati ciraṃ samavasthite vā kumbhāṃbarasya nahi ko'pi viśeṣaleśaḥ || 14|| saṅkalpamātrasavikalpitamūrtiviśvaṃ viśvaṃ ca satyamiti mūrcchitamandabuddhiḥ | cintāprakarṣajanitāṃ vanitāṃ viditvā śaiveti valgati yathā ciraviprayuktaḥ || 15|| svasye mayi svarasasatyasukhāvabodhe vyāmohanājjagaditi vyapadiśyate yat | anyatra kutracidadṛṣṭamarūparūpa masthānacitramiti niścinumastadetat || 16|| ādhyāsikasphuraṇabhedatirohito'pi ciddhāturekarasatāṃ na jahāti jātu | nānācarācaravicitravicitrito'pi citraḥ paṭo na paṭabhāvamapāsyati svam || 17|| saccit sukhātmakamakhaṇḍitamātmatattvaṃ manyeta kaścidahamityatiniścitārtham | dehendriyādakamapi vibhramavāsanābhi vyāpto mamāhamitiyadvadavidvadātmā || 18|| viśvaṃ mṛṣā virasamityavadhārya dhairya māsvādyate munibhirantarasau rasātmā | santāpajaṃ marumarīcirasaṃ nirasya saṃsevyate sumatibhissurasindhupūraḥ || 19|| ekāntasannihitamīdṛśamātmatattvaṃ lokā vimūḍhamatayo bata nādriyante | ākāśagocaramaśeṣajagatprakāśaṃ ghūkā na bhāskaramudīkṣitumutsahante || 20|| ānandavisphuraṇarūpamapi prapañca manyaṃ vibhāvya paritāpamupaiti mugdhaḥ | dīpādiṣu svavapuṣaḥ paridṛśyamānāṃ chāyāṃ vigāhya parimuhyati kiṃ na bālaḥ || 21|| māyā svakīyaviyadādivikārajālai rnātmānamanyathayituṃ prabhavatyasaṅgam | ādhārapuṣkarapalāśakamaṃbudhārā svīyaiḥ kimārdrayitumarhati śīkaraughaiḥ || 22|| ābhāsamātratanavo jagatīvikalpā māṃ na spṛśyantyapi vimuktasamastasaṅgam | āropitā malinatādivicitradharmā limpanti kiṃ nu vimalaṃ viyadantarālam || 23|| svapnassuṣuptirathajāgraditi hyavasthā stisro'pi śaśvadudayāstamayairupetāḥ | nirmokarājaya ivoragarājabhoge mayyeva sākṣiṇi vibhāntyanuvartamāne || 24|| svapnaḥ prajāgraditi śabdakṛto viśeṣo māyāmayatvamubhayorapi tulyameva | pratyagparāgiti nāmakṛto vikalpaḥ satyāvabodhasukhatāṃ tu tayossvarūpam || 25|| sarvendriyoparamaśāntajagadvikalpāḥ svānandamātrapariśeṣitacaityabodhe | te jāgrato'pyanubhavanti suṣuptyavasthāṃ krīḍanti ye satatamātmani satyabodhe || 26|| karteti kāyikaviceṣṭitadarśino māṃ gṛhṇanti cet kimu yathaiva tathā bhavāmi | pāriplavo'yamiti pāmaradhīgṛhīta ścandrastathā nahi calāṃbudasannikṛṣṭaḥ || 27|| mithyā samullasatu nāma jagadvicitra metāvatā vimalatatvavido na hāniḥ | svapne bhayaṅkaragajādinirīkṣaṇe'pi na svāpnakatvamanusandhadhato'sti bhītiḥ || 28|| atyantametadasadityapi cāvyavasthaṃ mayyātmadṛṣṭiranuvartata eva lokam | nāstyatra vaktramiti niścitavānapi drā gādatta eva mukuraṃ mukhadarśanāya || 29|| udbodhito'pi kabale kabale jananyā nidrālasaśśiśurivāviditānyabhāvaḥ | ālokayannapi bahirjagadindrajāla mantaḥ kayāpi kalayā na paricyuto'smi || 30|| dṛśye sphuṭībhavati nekṣyata eva bhūmā bhūmni sphuṭībhavati nekṣyata eva dṛśyam | dvīpāntare sphurati bhūmiriyaṃ na dṛśyā bhūmaṇḍale sphurati tacca tathā na dṛśyam || 31|| bodhe śanairupacayaṃ pratipadyamāne vicchidyate hṛdi tadā vimalaṃ bhramo'pi | candre kalābhiranuvāsaramedhamāne mandībhavatyapi yathaiva mahāndhakāraḥ ||32|| brahmānubhūtirasanirbharite munīndre karmānubandhavidhayo vimukhībhavanti | siddhopadarśitarasāyanapānatṛpte kinnu vyapākaviṣayā vidhayaḥ kramante || 33|| sarvātmatāmupagato'pi munissamādhiṃ pūrvānuvṛttamayate samayāpanutyai | paryāptasarvavibhavaḥ kṣitipo'pi kāla niryāpaṇāya juṣate caturaṅgalīlām || 34|| ātmajñamastamitasarvavidhipravṛtti mānandayanti nigamābhimatā niṣedhāḥ | vyāpāramātravimukhasya mahālasasya māśabdakavyavahṛtāni manoharāṇi || 35|| tattvānucintanaparo munisārvabhaumaḥ svacchandato vyavaharannapi nānuyojyaḥ | sāmrājyametya hi yathāruci vartamāno rājā prajābhiranuyoktumaśakya eva || 36|| prārabdhajāmadhikasaṃpadamāpadaṃ vā bhuñjāna eva puruṣaḥ pariśuddhiyeti | kiṃ vā''hituṇḍikagṛhītatanurbhujaṅga statklṛptadaṇḍanavidhiṃ parihartumīṣṭe || 37|| pūrvottarārjitaśubhāśubhakarmabhissva saṃpadvipaśca na bhavet paramārthadṛṣṭeḥ | jātyoṣarasya dhanavarṣajalābhiṣekai ratyoṣmaṇā ca nahi sasyavivṛddhihānī || 38|| prārabdhakarmaparipākavaśaṃvado na kliśnāti niścitaparāvadhirātmavedī | grāmāntamārgaparimāṇavidadhvanīno madhyepathaṃ na hi viṣīdati duḥkhito'pi || 39|| antarbahiśca paramārthatayānupaśyan na kliśyati vyasanamutkaṭamapyupetaḥ | dhīraḥ kilāhamukhe vijayaikadṛṣṭiḥ pratyarthibhiḥ pramathito'pi na viklavassyāt || 40|| prāpañcikastu vibhavaḥ paramādbhuto'pi dhīraṃ na rañjayati dṛṣṭatadīyatatvam | strīveṣabhūṣitatanuḥ puruṣo vilāsai stajñaṃ yuvānamapi mohayituṃ hi nālam || 41|| antarnirantaranigūḍhanijātmatatvo na prāgiva vyasanitāṃ viṣayeṣu dhatte | bhāgyāt kutaścidapi labdhanidhirmanasvī kiṃ pūrvavat kṛpaṇatāmurarīkaroti || 42|| adhyāsthitasvamahimānamalakriyā va dādhyātmikāśśubhaguṇāssvayamāviśanti | svādhīnite suhṛdi rājani tasya bhṛtyā ete'pi ca svayamupetya tamāśrayante || 43|| ajñānameva na kuto jagataḥ prasaṅgo jīveśadeśikavikalpakathā'pi dūre | ekāntanirmalacidekarasasvarūpaṃ brahmaiva kevalamahaṃ paripūrṇamasmi || 44|| iti śrīmatparamahaṃsa parivrājaka sadāśiva brahmendra viracitā advaitarasamañjarī sampūrṇā ||
